title: Art style?
author: Ok_Truth_324
selftext:
Obviously images can be generated to present the type of art style for your game but does anyone implement research into their style or just generate as they go? Example, I made a pool for my map. I'm a pool guy, so I'm adding details that actually make sense for the design of the pool i.e skimmer, sand filter, a valve. I'm not going crazy in detail but really just the type of art you can see mechanically makes sense. 

I do also like to do sketches and use AI to finalize things in detail. It's interesting because when I started about a year ago, my workflow was different. I actually find myself using AI as a critique tool rather than use it to do everything. I can't code. But the more I see bits and pieces of what it does the more I'm bringing to understand fundamentally how certain bits and pieces of code work. More ai has put me in a spot where I feel I use less ai. Anyone else?
